title: Grenadine
description: Pomegranate juice, sugar and lemon, warmed just until the sugar dissolves.
beforeYouStart: Have a clean airtight bottle and a funnel ready

steps.do: Combine everything in a medium saucepan over medium heat, about 8 min. Whisk as it warms so the sugar doesn't settle and catch on the bottom. Take it off before it boils.
steps.cue: Sugar fully dissolved, small bubbles just starting at the edges

steps.do: Pull from the heat and cool to room temperature, then funnel into the bottle and refrigerate.

items: Thicker: it comes out thinner than bottled grenadine (usually corn syrup and dye). Add more sugar, or hold it at a bare simmer a few minutes longer to reduce.
A pinch of salt or a splash of vanilla, stirred in after cooking (reader tip).
Airtight bottle in the fridge, about 1 month.
For a longer life, stir a couple tablespoons of vodka into the cooled syrup. It's no longer alcohol-free once you do.
Classic grenadine is pomegranate juice, water and sugar. This version uses all juice in place of the water, plus lemon for brightness.
In a pinch, maraschino cherry juice is sometimes used in place of grenadine, though it won't taste of pomegranate.
